pool_rule: Same immutable records, valid flags, past-only galleries and unique paired (frame,physicalID) keys as official frozen DINO diagnostic. Actual unknown candidates retained; no unknown identity negatives.
local_rule: Global head has no local descriptors. For other heads, L2-normalized same-region concat and reliability-weighted mean of local unit tokens are diagnostics only; no anatomy or local correspondence improvement claim.
scope: Heldout current-crop retrieval/discrimination after fixed finalepoch8 only. Actual and unique-paired GT/detector pools, rank1/rank5/mAP, nearest strictly earlier same-fish positive vs current-frame known-different-fish AUC/EER. Exact sample counts and same-input frozen reference parity required. Not full MOT, JEPA or online speed. No hyperparameter/checkpoint selection from outer results.
